declaration.candidate_semantics: Every candidate keeps v27's committee mix (ens_ctx, share 0.65), residual stage, outer weight 0.7 and floor; it changes only the two LIRF non-population blends: lirf_network (a weighted mean of LIRF network ensembles) and the per-scope (v9, tree, net) weights. Only LIRF non-population rows can change. Round A (configs/adsb_ctx_v2.json) changes only non-LIRF rows, so the two rounds touch disjoint rows.

control.recipe: v27 = configs/adsb_ctx_v1.json ctx_b100_s65 (committee mix ens_ctx at share 0.65; LIRF blends v25's: matched 0.15 v9 + 0.55 tree + 0.30 ens_nnl, unmatched 0.50 / 0.25 / 0.25)
control.reproduction: the control must reproduce these to 1e-9 s on every recipe month before any candidate is read

execution.network_hosts: Azure arcw0-arcw7, two lanes per worker once its round-A lanes finish (worker arcwN: seeds 301+N lane A, 309+N lane B), 8 threads, tools/ctx_chain.sh configs/adsb_ctx_network_lirf_v1.json ctx_lirf <seed> runs/adsb_ctx seasonal forward refit refit12 (launcher tools/ctx_launch_lirf_dev.sh)
execution.scorer: tools/run_adsb_ctx_lirf_dev.py; its --smoke (ens_ctx_lirf replaced by ens_nnl) must reproduce the control on all four months before --score

external_data: adsb.lol globe_history (ODbL) via the committee's ADS-B tables and match tables
IEM weather and OurAirports runways via the timeline bundle

ens_ctx.ensemble: ens_ctx = per-fold seed mean over the 16 learners (tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py convention), every leaf checked against the declared variant, code, configuration and seed
ens_ctx.folds: seasonal (predicts 2025-01/07), forward (2025-11), refit (Jan-Nov; December leaf cache runs/december/learners/runs__adsb_ctx__ctx_s<seed>.parquet, ranking), refit12 (Jan-Dec; ranking), run in that order per seed by tools/ctx_chain.sh
ens_ctx.status: v27's committee network, fitted under adsb_ctx_v1, unchanged

ens_ctx_lirf.ensemble: ens_ctx_lirf = per-fold seed mean over its 16 learners (tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py); December from the learners' January-November refit leaves
ens_ctx_lirf.folds: seasonal (predicts 2025-01/07), forward (2025-11), refit (Jan-Nov; December leaf cache runs/december/learners/runs__adsb_ctx__ctx_s<seed>.parquet, ranking), refit12 (Jan-Dec; ranking), run in that order per seed by tools/ctx_chain.sh

declaration.purpose: Round B development: the LIRF-inclusive context network (ens_ctx_lirf, 16 seeds) in v27's LIRF blends in place of, or beside, ens_nnl. Run under the user's override of the round-B design gate (docs/adsb_ctx_lirf/override_design_gate.json). Declared before any development fit of ctx_lirf.
declaration.selection: A candidate is eligible when: no recipe month is worse on ALL rows (ratio to the control <= 1.0); the mean ratio over the four recipe months is at least 0.02% below 1; and on every month where it changes a row the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval of the RMSE difference against the control lies below zero. Among eligible candidates choose the lowest mean ratio (ties by name); otherwise select nothing and keep v27. The rule of adsb_nn/nn2, unchanged.
declaration.ship: If a candidate is selected: the coverage-regime ship check (the gate of configs/adsb_ctx_regime_check_v1.json, both thinned months; July thins LIRF to its dark 2026 regime) is re-run for the selected candidate before any export; ranking tables from the refit12 seed means; the shipped incumbent's ranking values are rebuilt from their recorded components and must reproduce the uploaded file exactly; then the selected LIRF network and weights are applied, exported, verified independently (every saved context network reloaded and re-predicted), audited (tools/audit_export.py), and uploaded only with the user's approval. If round A also selects, the combined export applies both selections (disjoint rows), each exactly as selected.
